notes: Age-plus-calendar history is excluded from scoring.
Capacity and preferred use are separate for persuasion.
Engaging-work sustainability and depletion under extreme overload are not treated as opposites.
Rapid somatic phenomenology is scored; the user's ability to name it Splenic is not.
The 2026-08-22 18-item questionnaire has zero confirmatory status because it largely repeated prior constructs and contained malformed forced alternatives.
Personality-Moon-24 and Design-Mars-61 mappings are retained only in the best-current descriptive variant and are flagged post-selection. A second variant excludes both.
